ABOUT_INTRO: Frontend developer obsessed with the details, and how a site feels
ABOUT_DESCRIPTION:
For several years I've been building websites for businesses, from fast, easy-to-manage WordPress sites that clients can run themselves, to bespoke applications hand-built from scratch with Next.js and React.

What makes the difference is the care in the details: clean, fast interfaces, natural motion, and a genuine focus on the user experience. I work with modern tools like TypeScript, Tailwind, Framer Motion and headless CMS, and use Claude day to day to move faster and solve problems better. The result is websites that don't just look professional; they feel considered and work without friction.

IOR_CHALLENGE: A healthcare site has to inspire immediate trust and make sensitive information easy to find without overwhelming. A large amount of clinical content (services, specialists, technology) had to be organised legibly and accessibly, with interactions that lighten the reading.
IOR_SOLUTION: I built the site with WordPress and Elementor so the client could maintain content independently, and reinforced specific sections with custom jQuery to reveal and hide information dynamically. The result is a tidy site with clear visual hierarchy and simple navigation between services and team.
IOR_FEATURES: Independent content management with WordPress + Elementor
Custom jQuery interactions to reveal content
Clear presentation of services, medical team and facilities
AMMDE_CHALLENGE: The association needed a professional digital presence it could update itself, able to communicate its values, showcase events and turn visitors into members.
AMMDE_SOLUTION: I built the site with WordPress and Elementor, with a clear structure for mission, events and member benefits, and a simple interface so the team can manage content without relying on a developer.
AMMDE_FEATURES: Structure focused on mission, events and member acquisition
Professional design aligned with the association's identity
DRIVELANDM_CHALLENGE: The challenge was translating the energy of the motorsport world to the web while keeping service and vehicle information tidy and easy to browse.
DRIVELANDM_SOLUTION: I built the site with WordPress and Elementor, with a bold, visual design showcasing services, team, vehicles and events to attract new clients.
DRIVELANDM_FEATURES: Bold, visual design matching the motorsport world
PORTFOLIO_CHALLENGE: I wanted a portfolio that wouldn't look like yet another template, but something alive and detail-crafted, with solid performance, accessible and bilingual, without sacrificing smooth animation.
PORTFOLIO_SOLUTION: I built it with Next.js, Tailwind CSS and Framer Motion, with a scroll-driven work section (a 3D cube rotating through projects), es/en internationalisation via next-i18next, light/dark theme and carefully tuned micro-interactions.
COFRADIA_OVERVIEW: Official website for the Hermandad de la Divina Pastora, currently in development. The project goes beyond an informational site: it integrates a CMS so the brotherhood can manage its own content, plus foundations for member management, legal content and a store.
COFRADIA_CHALLENGE: A brotherhood needs a site it can maintain itself, with rich, structured content, while laying the groundwork for more complex features (members area, store, documents) on a modern, secure architecture.
COFRADIA_SOLUTION: I'm building it with Next.js 16 (App Router) and TypeScript, using Sanity as a headless CMS for editable content, Clerk for authentication, Neon (serverless Postgres) for data and Resend for email, all deployed on Vercel with a branch-based workflow and preview deployments.
COFRADIA_FEATURES: Foundations for members area and store
UNCLEIGGY_OVERVIEW: Online store for Uncle Iggy, my coloring-book brand and its Rascal Woods series (a raccoon family and their friends). It's far more than a showcase: its own store with payments, customer accounts, digital downloads, a blog, an interactive map of the characters' world and an admin panel with the business's accounting. Designed and built by me, end to end.
UNCLEIGGY_CHALLENGE: Selling digital products worldwide means solving everything you don't see: secure payments, per-country VAT, multiple currencies, invoices and refunds, user accounts and quarterly tax filings. All without losing what makes the brand special: an illustrated, warm and very fast site, in English and Spanish.
UNCLEIGGY_SOLUTION: I built it with Astro and TypeScript and serve it from my own VPS on IONOS: Node behind Caddy (automatic HTTPS), SQLite as the database and least-privilege systemd services, scheduled jobs and daily backups. Stripe handles checkout, webhooks and Stripe Tax; Clerk handles accounts (with Google sign-in); and Resend sends transactional email. Scheduled jobs send abandoned-cart reminders and store the ECB exchange rate. The site is static where it can be and dynamic where it needs to be, with a 4 KB first-party JavaScript budget and tests with Vitest.
UNCLEIGGY_FEATURES: Custom store with Stripe: checkout, webhooks, invoices and refunds
Multi-currency (€/$) and per-country VAT with Stripe Tax
Customer accounts with Clerk: purchases, downloads and recommendations
Admin panel with finances, sales imports and tax forms
Self-hosted on a VPS (IONOS): Node, Caddy, SQLite, systemd and daily backups
Bilingual, with a blog and an interactive map; 4 KB of first-party JS
MBDREAMLIVING_OVERVIEW: MB Dream Living is a luxury holiday-rentals company in Marbella. An end-to-end project: I developed their corporate identity, the designs, the website and the booking-engine integration, and led the company's communication and marketing for a year.
MBDREAMLIVING_CHALLENGE: A high-end vacation-rental brand has to convey trust and aspiration (luxury Marbella), let guests search and book effortlessly, and keep a consistent identity across every channel. Everything had to be built from scratch: brand, website and presence.
MBDREAMLIVING_SOLUTION: A 360° engagement: I created the corporate identity and visual system, designed and built the website with WordPress and Elementor (with custom CSS, JavaScript and PHP) and integrated the booking engine for real-time search and availability. I also ran the company's communication and marketing for a year.
MBDREAMLIVING_FEATURES: Corporate identity and visual system from scratch
Web design & development (WordPress + Elementor, custom CSS/JS/PHP)
Communication and marketing management for a year
Focused on a luxury, trust-building brand for Marbella holiday rentals
